title: Supervision idle_seconds should expose the running shell session list so orchestrators can self-serve hang diagnosis
wanted_capability: When a bro sits idle, the orchestrator currently gets bare idle_seconds and must guess between wedged, thinking, and blocked-on-long-child. The fix child for gap-aa2baeb3 found that making the daemon classify hangs would flip two deliberate contracts: supervision.rs's neutral-idle design (idle_seconds asserts nothing by design) and shell.rs's no-low-cap yield contract. The sanctioned shape instead: annotate the supervision surface with the running shell session list (from shell_list) so the orchestrator can self-serve the diagnosis without the daemon asserting severity. Wanted: idle_seconds plus the active shell sessions (id, command head, age) in the supervision payload, or a documented probe composition that returns both in one call.
missing_primitive: A supervision-surface field (or sibling probe) that annotates idle_seconds with the currently running shell sessions from shell_list.
fallback_used: Orchestrators poll shell_list by hand when a bro goes quiet (as done for the 2026-08-16 rg incident in gap-aa2baeb3).
evidence: fix child report on branch fix/shell-run-stdin-open-pipe (d1f95d3c, 97fffd1f)
crates/bro-tools/src/shell.rs no-low-cap yield contract; supervision.rs neutral-idle design comment
notes: Filed by the gap manager 2026-08-19 as the deferred second half of gap-aa2baeb3. The stdin root cause is fixed; this is the residual observability half. Design-shaped: touches the supervision surface contract, so it wants a design decision before a diff.
